updates.coverageDescription: Applies to residential rental properties in San Diego subject to just-cause eviction requirements, excluding deed-restricted or regulatory-agreement affordable housing (exempted by S.D.M.C. § 98.0703(c)-(d)). The rule applies to all multifamily residential rental buildings not within the exemptions listed in § 98.0703.
updates.coverageQuote: The landlord shall give written notice to the tenant at least 30 or 60 days prior to the proposed date of termination as required by California Civil Code section 1946.1

updates.coverageDescription: Applies to residential rental properties in San Diego subject to just-cause eviction requirements for no-fault terminations, excluding deed-restricted or regulatory-agreement affordable housing (exempted by S.D.M.C. § 98.0703(c)-(d)). The relocation assistance requirement applies when a landlord terminates a tenancy for no-fault just cause under § 98.0704(b).
